compiled_state.title: record-review.sh: sources $HOOK_DIR/lib/deps.sh -> path nonexistent (deps.sh lives at hooks/lib/, script lives in scripts/) -> commit blocked
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Technical Environment
- Plugin: dso (worktree + main, both broken)
- File: plugins/dso/scripts/record-review.sh:44
- code_version: 52991360fd254bf31333169263863c7e6d5fcb4d

## Incident Overview
- Scenario Type: Discovered during /dso:fix-bug f6fd commit phase

### Expected Behavior
record-review.sh sources its dependency library (deps.sh) successfully so it can compute artifacts paths and write the review-status file consumed by pre-commit-review-gate.sh.

### Actual Behavior
Line 44 reads: `source "$HOOK_DIR/lib/deps.sh"` where HOOK_DIR is the script's own directory (plugins/dso/scripts/). The path `plugins/dso/scripts/lib/deps.sh` does not exist — deps.sh lives at `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh`. Every other plugin script in scripts/ correctly sources `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lib/deps.sh` or equivalent. record-review.sh is the only file with this bug.

Reproduction: `bash plugins/dso/scripts/record-review.sh --expected-hash X --reviewer-hash Y` exits 1 with stderr: `plugins/dso/scripts/record-review.sh: line 44: plugins/dso/scripts/lib/deps.sh: No such file or directory`.

### Action History
Observed during the commit phase of /dso:fix-bug f6fd-af80-9b13-4649. REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 5 invokes record-review.sh via commit-step.sh — the call fails identically because the broken source line short-circuits the script before any work is done.

Introduced in commit 172d83af08 (Pre-surfacing reviewer-findings verifier agent F4+F5 bundle, #124).

## Skills and Workflows
- Affected workflow: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md Step 5 (Record Review)
- Affected hook: pre-commit-review-gate.sh — blocks commits when review-status is missing (because record-review.sh failed to write it)

## Additional Details
Fix: change line 44 from `source "$HOOK_DIR/lib/deps.sh"` to `source "$HOOK_DIR/../hooks/lib/deps.sh"` (or the canonical `source "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lib/deps.sh"` pattern used by other scripts). Same fix applies to lines 47 and 50 (config-paths.sh, merge-state.sh) — both also live at hooks/lib/, not scripts/lib/.

Workaround applied this session: temporary symlinks at plugins/dso/scripts/lib/{deps,config-paths,merge-state}.sh → ../../hooks/lib/{deps,config-paths,merge-state}.sh, used to write review-status during this commit, then removed.

Related: f6fd-af80-9b13-4649 (originating bug); f46f-9696-65cf-4586 (enforcement-gate.sh dso.workflow gap).
